## Open Data & Statistics (191)

- [Canadian Database of Geochemical Surveys (CDoGS)](https://geochem.nrcan.gc.ca/cdogs/content/main/home_en.htm) — Canada · Federal · Survey database · geochemistry, surveys, mineral-exploration, xls — Catalogue of 1,600+ regional geochemical surveys across Canada with standardized raw analytical data downloads as spreadsheets, KML maps and WMS, plus element search.
- [Canadian Geographical Names Database Search](https://geonames.nrcan.gc.ca/search-place-names/search) — Canada · Federal · Lookup tool · place names, geography, gazetteer, api — Query nearly 350,000 official Canadian place names by name, coordinates or area, with API access and downloadable datasets, maintained by NRCan.
- [Canadian Heritage — Grants and Contributions Search](https://search.open.canada.ca/grants?owner_org=pch) — Canada · Federal · Funding database · grants, funding, csv, arts — Search 138,000+ Canadian Heritage grant/contribution agreements by recipient, program, value, year and province; whole dataset also downloadable as CSV.

- [EODMS — Earth Observation Data Management System](https://eodms-sgdot.nrcan-rncan.gc.ca/index-en.html) — Canada · Federal · Imagery search · aerial photos, satellite imagery, historical, nrcan — Search and order from NRCan's archive of satellite imagery and the National Air Photo Library — over 3 million historical aerial photos of Canada dating to the 1920s, with footprints on a map.

## Planning, Zoning & Development (86)

- [Codes Canada — CODES-GUIDES Online Library](https://nrc.canada.ca/en/certifications-evaluations-standards/codes-canada/codes-guides-online-library) — Canada · Federal · Reference library · building code, fire code, construction, standards — Free electronic access to the National Building Code, Fire Code, Plumbing Code, Energy Code and user's guides published by the NRC.

Case status portal covers active files.
- [Abbotsford Development Data — Development Application Tracker](https://www.abbotsford.ca/developmentdata) — Abbotsford · Municipal · Dataset · Abbotsford, development permits, rezoning, subdivision — Live searchable reporting system tracking development activity in Abbotsford — covers development variance permits (in progress, issued current/previous year, with approval in principle), instream development applications, rezoning applications (at 3rd reading, in progress, final approval current/previous year), and subdivision applications (in progress, final approval, preliminary layout approvals). Each report lists application details, addresses, and status; export results to CSV, Excel, or PDF. Useful for monitoring construction, land use change, and development trends without filing a FOI request.

## Council, Democracy & Transparency (128)

- [House of Commons — Vote Records](https://www.ourcommons.ca/members/en/votes) — Canada · Federal · Vote tracker · parliament, votes, mps, accountability — Every recorded vote in the House of Commons with each MP's position, browsable by parliament and session and downloadable as open XML data.

- [Orders in Council Database](https://orders-in-council.canada.ca/) — Canada · Federal · Search database · orders in council, government decisions, transparency — Privy Council Office's searchable database of all federal Orders in Council from 1990 to present, with full text from late 2002 onward, published three working days after approval.

## Telecommunications & Digital (18)

- [Canada.ca Design System — Templates and Patterns](https://design.canada.ca/) — Canada · Federal · Design system · design-system, templates, web, developers — Download user-tested Canada.ca page templates, design patterns, and style specifications to build compliant Government of Canada web content.
- [Canada's Connectivity Strategy — Project Map & Reports](https://ised-isde.canada.ca/site/canada-connectivity-strategy/en) — Canada · Federal · Program data · broadband, connectivity, funding, rural internet — Federal broadband program transparency: funded connectivity projects, target speeds, households connected, and progress reporting toward universal rural internet.
- [Canadian Digital Service](https://digital.canada.ca/) — Canada · Federal · Agency · digital, government — CDS — builds and supports digital government services across federal departments
- [Canadian Digital Service — GitHub Organization](https://github.com/cds-snc) — Canada · Federal · Open source code · open source, github, cds, digital government — Nearly 300 open-source repositories behind GC Notify, GC Forms and GC Design System components — read, fork and reuse real production government service code.
- [CRTC — Broadband Internet Service Complaints](https://www.ccts-cprst.ca/) — Canada · Federal · Complaint · CRTC, complaints — Submit complaints about broadband, wireless, or TV providers via the CCTS
- [CRTC — Communications Monitoring Report](https://crtc.gc.ca/eng/publications/reports/policymonitoring/2023/index.htm) — Canada · Federal · Report · CRTC, data — Annual data on Canadian broadcasting, wireless, and internet markets
- [CRTC — National Broadband Map](https://crtc.gc.ca/eng/internet/internet.htm) — Canada · Federal · Map · broadband, map — Interactive map showing internet speeds and coverage across Canada

- [Government of Canada — GitHub Organization](https://github.com/canada-ca) — Canada · Federal · Open source code · open source, github, code, digital government — Browse, fork and reuse 70+ official open-source repositories — the Canada.ca design system, the domain-security Tracker, and the Open Resource Exchange.
